workflow_rationale: This is a refactor workflow because we are splitting a 3,667-line monolithic component into smaller, maintainable modules without changing functionality. We must maintain backward compatibility and follow the Add New → Migrate → Remove Old → Cleanup pattern.

Successfully resolved React version mismatch and verified typecheck. Fixed monorepo-wide React type conflict by adding @types/react@^18.3.27 and @types/react-dom@^18.3.7 to pnpm overrides in package.json. This aligns TypeScript types with React 18 runtime and eliminates dual @types/react installation (18 and 19). All booking-engine components now type-check successfully with 0 errors. Only 1 pre-existing error remains in mobile-nav.tsx (unrelated to refactoring). Verification: pnpm --filter @xala/ds typecheck shows booking-engine directory has no errors. Committed as abee7d9.

Design system compliance scan completed. Found 566 pre-existing violations that were NOT introduced by this refactoring. Verified by comparing compliance at HEAD~23 (before refactoring) vs HEAD (after refactoring) - both show identical 566 violations. Our refactoring simply split existing code into modules without changing implementation. Design system compliance issues should be addressed in a separate task focused on fixing design token usage.
